post.fileName: now Just finished reading Anxiety by Samir Chopra.md
post.html: The book felt like it was written for me. I learned so much from it, got so much to think about, so much to shed, so much to unpack. I feel resolved to live a more authentic life, to take anxiety as a sign of disintegrated self, and to believe "self" to be somewhere between self and no-self.
